mapper.select: SELECT qc.*, u.name as operator_name, u.department as operator_department, c.product_id, c.vault, f.order_number as qc_order_number, f.notes as qc_notes, f.date as qc_date, p.name as product_name, p.material_number FROM arrival_qc_record qc LEFT JOIN user u ON qc.operator_id = u.id LEFT JOIN application_content c ON qc.content_id = c.id LEFT JOIN application_form f ON qc.qc_application_id = f.id LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE 1=1 AND qc.content_id = #{contentId} AND qc.qc_application_id = #{qcApplicationId} AND qc.operator_id = #{operatorId} ORDER BY qc.operation_time DESC
